question: What are the common patterns can be observed from countries with high income inequality in 2015, knowing gini greater than 0.4 is considered as high inequality
query: To find countries with high income inequality (Gini > 0.4) in the year 2015, you can use the following SQL query:  ```sql SELECT country, gini_reported, gini_recalculated, data_source FROM country_income WHERE year = 2015 AND gini_reported > 0.4 LIMIT 50; ```  This query will return the country name, reported Gini coefficient, recalculated Gini coefficient, and data source for up to 50 countries with high income inequality in the year 2015.
